subject: BrightPath SIG: SSO token traces & RBAC snapshot delivery plan
messages:
From: BrightPath Health Compliance <compliance@brightpathhealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightpathhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG artifacts needed for provisioning/SSO/RBAC

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BrightPath is working through the SIG questionnaire and we need a handful of artifacts to close the technical controls sections related to access control and provisioning. Can you provide the following by EOD Apr 14 (our submission deadline)?

- SCIM delta exports (last 30 days) showing user create/update/delete events and attribute mappings
- Sample SAML assertion(s) for an interactive login (include the raw assertion XML with timestamps and issuer audience)
- RBAC snapshot (roles -> members) and a brief owner map (who owns each role)
- SSO/session token traces for the last 90 days (redacted PII allowed) showing token issuance and refresh events for service accounts and human users
- Short note (1 paragraph) on how least-privilege is enforced for applications that call Redwood APIs

If there are any constraints on delivery format or if you prefer us to accept an S3 share/secure transfer, let me know. Also flag anything that needs a non-disclosure preface.

Best,
Nate Henderson
Compliance Manager
BrightPath Health

Nate — thanks for the list and the deadline. We can deliver everything you requested. Quick plan:

1) Kimberly will pull the SCIM delta exports and RBAC snapshot (CSV).
2) Vanessa will extract sample SAML assertions and generate a short redaction guide.
3) I will assemble SSO/session token trace (redacted) and write the least-privilege paragraph.

Delivery options: we can upload a password-protected zip to the Drive link below, or provide a signed S3 pre-signed URL. Preference? We usually share through a time-limited Drive folder for SIGs.

Kim/Vanessa — can you confirm ETA for your artifacts so I can consolidate and send a single package to Nate by 2028-04-13?

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
